title: Law to ban the fastest e-bikes on city streets
summary: This bill would prohibit operating class 3 e-bicycles, which can reach 25 mph with motor power alone, on city streets, in parks and in other public places. Violators would get warnings only until April 1, 2029, after which fines would rise from $0 for a first violation to $50 and then $100 for later violations within two years, and repeat unsafe riders could have their e-bike impounded. The law would take effect 24 months after passage.
